**Google Doc title:** `Meridian Program Quarterly Review Attendees`

**Meeting:** Meridian Program Quarterly Review, 24 September 2026, 13:00 AEST

> This fixture drives bug #13, where the External Meeting Prep agent froze on
> "Enrich Attendee Directory Data" for a large invite list. The list is
> deliberately long enough (24 people, 8 sites, 24 distinct cost centres) to
> put the directory enrichment step under the same kind of load, and the
> counts at the bottom give the run a deterministic answer to check rather
